General Dhiraj Seth Assumes Charge as India's New Army Chief

General Dhiraj Seth has taken over as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff, succeeding General Upendra Dwivedi. The change of command ceremony took place in New Delhi. General Dwivedi, upon his retirement, remarked on the army's performance and the future of warfare, emphasizing joint and integrated operations.
